projects.name: Villa Hydra Luxury Residences
projects.short_description: Premium residential complex of 150 apartments in Hydra, Algiers' most prestigious neighborhood
projects.description:
Villa Hydra Luxury Residences represents the pinnacle of modern Algerian living. This exceptional development offers 150 premium apartments ranging from 85m² to 220m², thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of discerning families seeking the ultimate in comfort and sophistication.

The development features three interconnected buildings surrounding a landscaped courtyard, each offering breathtaking views of the Bay of Algiers. Every residence combines contemporary architecture with subtle Mediterranean influences, creating spaces that are both elegant and functional.

Residents enjoy access to premium amenities including a state-of-the-art fitness center, children's play area, underground parking for 300 vehicles, and 24/7 concierge services. The location in Hydra places you within minutes of international schools, healthcare facilities, and the city center.
